title: The first Memphis Five record and The Sheik
summary: Kirkeby cannot name the first Memphis Five record. The Sheik was a California Ramblers side with Phil Napoleon on an Aeolian date, and he supervised and booked the Memphis Five for some time.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Yes, these fellows seemed to have great respect for each other. Even the non-jazz players used to visit Ellington and used to visit the Harlem bands to hear the tremendous sound they were producing. But just to step back again to the early years, do you remember what the name of the first record was that you made with the Memphis Five?
Now you've got me. I'd have to look that up.
Do you think the Sheik might have been the first record?
No, the Sheik was the California Ramblers.
Oh, the Sheik was the California Ramblers. That's right. All right.
But the funny part of it is, I had Philly Napoleon in that band.
Oh, yes. That's where I confused. You had Napoleon with the California Ramblers on that first Ramblers record. On the date. That's it.
Yeah. Now, in the earlier records of the Memphis Five, you may or may not have been supervisor of recording and so forth.
I did. I think I made their first records and booker and supervisor of their dates for some time.
There's a terrific string of records of the Memphis Five.
That's right. That's right. That's right.
